sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited data type with an empty case: a value of this type has no constructors, so from an impossible input the function may return any type.
sketches.resonance: Absence promises everything precisely because it can never arrive.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table field removes that key from the table rather than storing a nil value.
sketches.resonance: To become nothing is not to remain empty, but to be erased from the map of what exists.

sketches.mechanism: An ensure clause runs even while a method is returning, and an exception raised there overrides the return.
sketches.resonance: The last obligation is stronger than leaving.
sketches.draft:
def leave
  return
ensure
  raise
end
